name: Red Hoodie Kid
about: The 2D Explainer's own hero: a young person in a red hoodie, jeans and white sneakers, the on-screen you of every explainer.
heightNote: the source skill gives no height: a young teenager's

can.viewNotes: the kit's front, back and profile (faces left); three-quarter is the front with its own head turn (headTurn), the body narrowed by the app
can.faceNotes: the kit's mouth (-1..1), worry and blink; laugh, surprised, angry and talk add the app's hooks to its own brows and mouth (brow lift, inner brow press, mouth opening)
can.poseNotes: the kit's own sleeves and legs cut at the elbow and knee and turned by the app about the shoulder, elbow, hip and knee: point, wave, reach in front; walk and sit in profile (sit on a plain stool the app paints)
can.hands: n/a: the kit's one relaxed hand
can.walk: the app's cycle of the kit's profile legs (thigh and shin turned; the kit has no walk of its own)
can.talk: the mouth opens and closes by turns; no lip sync

credit.author: Moworks Studio (the owner's 2D Explainer source skill)
credit.madeNote: the source skill's own hero as shipped; its name is the app's (the source gives none); what its drawing lacks is drawn by the app (house/explainer-2d.js, posing the kit's own pieces through house/explainer-2d-hooks.mjs)
